scenario: Issue #231 adoption and Quick Open measurement: tab-strip and workspace-tree keyed regions adopted from the pilot; three-arm matched comparison plain vs adopted vs adopted+QuickOpen-results on the same Alicorn master, with a new env-gated Quick Open filter-typing step.

alicorn.subject: research(231): pilot keyed regions in Scratchpad and measure the burden
alicorn.instrumentation: None added to Alicorn. Regions, invalidate_region, monotonic-revision checks, and stage timers are the landed master implementation. Alicorn runtime suite: 497/497 green (dev-2026-11-nightly:08539cd).

scratchpad.base_subject: fix(alikit): anchor the command palette like Quick Open
scratchpad.same_source: All three are fresh clones of the same base commit. All three carry the same env-gated benchmark hook (adoption-harness.patch). Plain differs by no product change; adopted differs by adoption-tabstrip-tree.patch; quickopen differs from adopted by quickopen-results.patch.

adoption.origin: https://github.com/samanshaiza004/scratchpad.git (branch pushed; the clone's default origin is the local source checkout, to which the branch was also pushed)
adoption.converted_invalidate_sites: None. The pilot's only two invalidate_region conversions (quick_open_text_change, quick_open_move_selection) feed the Quick Open results slot, which is not adopted. The tab strip and tree rebuild through their revision signatures on the ordinary root invalidation path.
adoption.frontend_suite: 259/259 green (go test + odin check + bridge tests + frontend tests, release-independent test build)

adoption-harness.patch.provenance: Reuses the phase-2 24-character editor typing hook patch byte-for-byte as its base (scratchpad-perf-typing-hook.patch, SHA-256 8640D486BDF275CD1E85473796C8E85DA5B4EEA3EDDE46806C93DD9B2834ED86, itself the nine-action sequence hook plus the typing burst). The delta adds the new env-gated SCRATCHPAD_ALICORN_PERF_QUICKOPEN filter burst and reorders the phases (sequence, editor typing, Quick Open) so each measured phase runs in its own process.

sequence-counters-diagnostic.patch.provenance: Diagnostic-only variant of the harness that prints Frame_Stats deltas per nine-action step. Built into separate out/diag binaries; the A/B binaries are unchanged. Counters are integer totals and do not depend on optimization level.

scratchpad.placeholder_deps: .deps/alicorn and .deps/caliber are directory junctions in each clone; --alicorn-root selected this Alicorn worktree for every build. caliber.ps1 sync is skipped because Caliber rejects junctions outside .deps; builds invoke go run ./cmd/alicorn-dev directly with the pinned Caliber checkout.
scratchpad.quickopen_query: "application/sample_" (19 characters) delivered one commit per step through alicorn.process_text_input on the Quick Open query text-field node, then dispatched through the application's normal Text_Change callback (command_palette_text_change). The query field is outside the measured results-slot region.

toolchain.renderer: SDL_GPU reference host; no SCRATCHPAD_RENDERER override.

display.note: Logical window size equals pixel size; no DPI transition or continuous resize.

theme: Scratchpad default Warm theme; no appearance fixture or saved preference.

builds.artifact_manifests: logs/artifact-manifest-{plain,adopted,quickopen}.json all pin Alicorn bd81fe5... and Caliber 197cd96...

protocol.requested_minimum: 5 primary + 2 confirmation pairs per arm comparison. The capture kept the phase-2/pilot precedent of 7+3 because the first seven pairs showed stall-driven spread above 25% in every scenario (one 800 ms adopted sequence process, 367/154 ms plain typing processes, a 557 ms plain Quick Open process). No sample was discarded.
protocol.order: Six balanced arm orders (every arm occupies each position twice); order alternates across the ten rounds. One unmeasured warmup per arm per scenario before the primary rounds.
protocol.retries: An acceptance failure is retried up to three times with the failed log preserved. One typing sample required a second attempt (quickopen arm, primary run-03). All 90 measured samples and 9 warmups passed smoke and scenario acceptance.

scenarios.sequence: Nine actions: open README, open the 5,002-line Go document, switch back to README, open Quick Open, close it after the index is ready, open Settings, close Settings, close README, close the remaining Go document.
scenarios.typing: Open the 5,002-line fixture document (setup, unmeasured), then 24 committed single-character text-input events through editor_text_input, one measured step per character.
scenarios.quickopen: Open Quick Open and wait for the path index and query focus (setup, unmeasured), then 19 committed query characters through process_text_input + the application Text_Change callback, one measured step per character; close Quick Open in the measured tail.

protocol.cadence: First action 500 ms after start; later actions advance after the previous description was built, with a 30 ms floor.
metrics: scenario_build_ns (sum of measured application describe windows)
protocol.percentile: Nearest-rank p50/p95 (floor index), matching the prior captures.

typing_plain_to_adopted.stalls: Two plain-arm processes contain startup stalls (63.5% and 84.2% paired differences); the remaining eight pairs are negative.

quickopen_plain_to_adopted.note: The one skip is the workspace tree (no document is open, so the tab strip builds no region). The 29-node difference is the cached tree body.

quickopen_adopted_to_quickopen.conclusion: The results-slot region never skips while the query changes: emitted counts and skip counts are identical to the adopted arm in all 180 filter-character samples. The measured describe-window difference has no counter counterpart and is not claimed as a region benefit.

sequence.diagnostic_step_counters: Adopted arm skips the tab strip and tree on every step (2-7 skips per step depending on description passes); quickopen arm reports exactly the same skips as adopted in all nine steps, so the results region adds no skip to open/close either.
sequence.conclusion: No reliable sequence signal. One adopted process stalled (800 ms, +2415% pair), step 7 changes pass count 5 vs 4 in the quickopen arm, and steps outside Quick Open are a null control that shows build-layout noise up to -19.7%. Do not read the sequence medians as a region effect.

limitations: The measured hooks invoke application/backend command paths and committed text changes on a schedule; they are not native keyboard/pointer input and do not measure input latency.

The runner generates workspace/ and per-run profile-* directories inside each results directory; they are reproducible from the runner and are not committed. Process logs, CSVs, and build/test logs are committed.
Startup stalls occurred in all three arms (one per scenario at 99-800 ms). They inflate p95 and are retained in the raw samples; medians are used for the headline.

The reference host exits smoke at 3 s after startup. Slow first submissions (up to 1.3 s cold) can consume the window; one sample needed a retry. The retry policy is recorded and the failed log is kept.
The nine-action diagnostic counter variant uses separate binaries built from the same sources plus the counter-print block; its timings are not used.
The Quick Open burst types an ASCII path query into the query field; it does not exercise IME composition, selection moves, scrolling, or result-row activation.
The sequence has no per-step counters outside the diagnostic variant; the A/B sequence capture has build windows and pass counts only.
One host, one Odin build, display scale 1.0, SDL_GPU reference host. Do not compare across machines.
Region revisions remain application-declared; the two mechanism tests cover stale-output detection, not input completeness for future edits.
